en: A vintage handwritten postcard on aged brown paper, written in Spanish cursive. The text begins with the place and date line at the top: "Constantinopla, el 20 de julio 1910". The rest is a dense, neatly written message discussing a dramatic work titled "Don Isaac" and its reception in Constantinople, including mentions of newspapers and possible publication in Spain. A small printed label in the bottom left corner reads "M.C.D.2020".
